fit_partition: train only; validation and test remain untouched in source corpus
history_policy: Entire conversation prefix from first user through target; no cropped earlier turns
selection: At most two targets per original connected group, prefer deepest contextual then standalone then lexical deferral candidate
prefix_family_adjustment: inverse square root frequency inside each bucket, computed from selected training targets only
limits: Lexical deferral is a candidate label, not proof that uncertainty is unwarranted.
High verbatim repetition filter may reject legitimate repetitive writing.
Bucket proportions are a new experimental hypothesis, not validated conversation quality.
The new 8192-token vocabulary is incompatible with old 2048-token checkpoints; new pretraining is required.
